scenario: A 22-year-old man took many aspirin tablets. pH is 7.48, PCO2 is 22, the anion gap is 20, and he has ringing ears. He is warm. A classmate gives a benzodiazepine and no alkali.
question: What acid-base pattern is this, and how is the drug trapped?
options: Acidify the urine to trap the drug
A single respiratory alkalosis, so the gap is ignored
Mixed picture. Trap the drug in alkaline urine
Naloxone, because ringing ears mean an opioid
correctAnswer: Mixed picture. Trap the drug in alkaline urine
citation: Katzung BG, Vanderah TW. Basic and Clinical Pharmacology. 15th ed. McGraw Hill; 2021.
examTakeaway: Salicylate overdose causes a respiratory alkalosis and an anion-gap acidosis, tinnitus, and fever. Alkalinization of urine traps the drug.
